gaps.term: Real part of z_k is a multiple of 2^{-p}
gaps.note: The page calls z_k a Gaussian dyadic number, which may have any power-of-two denominator. The claim that its real part has denominator 2^p needs z_k to be stored with p fractional bits after the pointwise products, which the page does not say (it only gives the error per stage as a multiple of 2^{-p}). The reader cannot check this from the page.
